turns.question: What was net revenue on 1 October 2026, after partner returns?
turns.answer: Net revenue on 1 October 2026 was EUR 964.19 (a single day, 2026-10-01). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: How was that number computed?
turns.answer: The net revenue metric is defined as: "Revenue minus partner returns (finance's net sales)." In plain words, the query summed the amounts of non-cancelled orders placed on 1 October 2026, subtracted the amounts of partner returns recorded on 1 October 2026 (counted on their return date), and got EUR 964.19. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
